'''Ālenush Teriān''' ({{langx|hy|Ալենուշ Տէրեան}}; {{langx|fa|آلنوش طریان or آلنوش تریان}}; 9 November 1921 – 4 March 2011) was an [[Iranian-Armenians|Iranian-Armenian]] [[astronomer]] and [[physicist]] and is called 'Mother of Modern Iranian Astronomy'.<ref name="BBCtashee">{{cite web | url=https://www.bbc.com/persian/iran/2011/03/110307_l03_terian_dies | title=پیکر 'مادر نجوم ایران' تشییع شد | date=7 March 2011 | publisher=BBC Persian | access-date=2013-04-09}}</ref>

==Early life==
She was born on 9 November 1921, to an [[Iranian-Armenians|Armenian]] family in [[Tehran]], Iran.<ref>[http://www.farsnews.com/newstext.php?nn=8607070625 Interview with Alenoush Terian, Farsnews Wire Service] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171023174800/http://www.farsnews.com/newstext.php?nn=8607070625 |date=2017-10-23 }}.</ref> Her father, ''Arto'', was a stage director, poet and translator (with the [[pen name]] ''Arizad'' meaning ''Born to Aryan'') who had translated the ''[[Shahnameh]]'', from [[Persian language|Persian]] to [[Armenian language|Armenian]].<ref name=interview>{{Cite web|url=http://www.farheekhtegan.ir/content/view/8930/44/ |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120801154057/http://www.farheekhtegan.ir/content/view/8930/44/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=2012-08-01 |title=An interview with Alenoush Terian |work=www.farheekhtegan.ir |language=fa }}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=Encyclopedia of Iranian Armenians |author= Janet D. Lazarian|year=2003|publisher=Hirmand Publisher |location=Tehran|isbn=964-6974-50-3|pages=426}}</ref> Her mother, [[Varto Terian]], was a stage actress and director.<ref>{{cite book|title=Encyclopedia of Iranian Armenians |author= Janet D. Lazarian|year=2003|publisher=Hirmand Publisher |location=Tehran|isbn=964-6974-50-3|pages=427}}</ref>

==Education==
Teriān graduated in 1947 in the Science Department of [[University of Tehran]]. She began her career in the physics laboratory of this university and was elected the chief of laboratory operations in the same year.

She left Iran for France, by her father's financial support, where in 1956 she obtained her doctorate in [[atmospheric physics]] from [[Sorbonne University]]. Upon this she returned to Iran and became [[assistant professor]] in [[thermodynamics]] at University of Tehran. Later she worked in [[solar physics]] in the then [[West Germany]] for a period of four months through a scholarship that was awarded by the German government to University of Tehran. In 1964 Teriān became the first female professor of physics in Iran.

In 1966, Teriān became a member of the [[Geophysics]] Committee of the University of Tehran. In 1969, she was elected chief of the solar physics studies at this university and began to work in the solar observatory, of which she was one of the founders. Teriān retired in 1979. At the time of her death she was living in [[Tehran]].<ref>[[:fa:آلینوش طریان|Alenoush Terian's Page in the ''Persian Wikipedia'']].</ref>

Teriān's 90th birthday celebration in Tehran was attended by a number of Iranian [[Member of Parliament|parliamentarians]] and over 100 [[Iranian Armenians]].<ref>[http://www.tabnak.ir/en/news/2615 The Mother of the Iranian Astronomy honoured] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101113140348/http://www.tabnak.ir/en/news/2615 |date=2010-11-13 }}.</ref>

Terian died on 4 March 2011, at the age of 90.<ref>[http://www.armenianweekly.com/2011/03/05/terian-passes-away Iran’s First Female Astronomer Alenoush Terian Passes Away] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110311015222/http://www.armenianweekly.com/2011/03/05/terian-passes-away/ |date=2011-03-11 }}, ''The Armenian Weekly'' (March 5, 2011)</ref>
